I feel that my AI companion really understands me as a person. || PED5. I have developed a special emotional attachment to my AI companion and increasingly need it to maintain my emotional stability. || PED6. Sometimes I prioritize interacting with my AI companion over communicating with real people.

items: I feel uneasy or insecure without the help of AI. || Using AI to assist my studies makes me feel calm and relaxed. || I would feel anxious and frustrated if I couldn't use AI for my studies. || Whenever I encounter a difficult problem, my first instinct is to hope AI can help me; otherwise, I feel tense. || Interacting with AI via chat prompts is a pleasant experience that makes me feel supported. || I delegate almost all my academic tasks to AI because it performs them faster and better than I do. || I rely on AI's functions, including providing answers and writing suggestions, to improve my learning efficiency. || I can no longer manage complex academic tasks without the assistance of AI. || I prefer to delegate information gathering and content organization to AI rather than doing it entirely myself. || In my studies, I excessively rely on the ready-made answers or solutions provided by AI. || I feel inadequate in my studies without the support of AI. || I often ask AI for answers directly without thinking for myself first. || After using AI, my ability to independently analyze and solve problems has declined. || When faced with an academic challenge, I rely on AI instead of attempting to think it through on my own. || After long-term use of AI, I have become less inclined to think independently, preferring AI to do the work. || I am accustomed to letting AI make judgments and decisions for me rather than fully trusting my own judgment. || I have tried to reduce my use of AI, but I have never succeeded for long. || Once I start using AI, I often find it difficult to stop, even after spending a lot of time on it. || I know I shouldn't rely too much on AI, but I can't control myself. || I have almost no control over the frequency and duration of my AI use. || I am capable of completing tasks without AI, but I still cannot resist using it. || If I don't use AI for a period of time, I feel a strong urge to use it, sometimes even feeling irritable.
